assessment_due_on.description: The last day to assess it: 30 days after awareness, in Singapore.

assessment_overdue.description: true when it is not assessed and that day has passed.

aware_at.description: When the company became aware of it: the assessment's 30 days run from it.

items.description: A kind of data: a name or identification number with pay, card or bank account numbers, or credentials, is prescribed.

examples: The October payroll file went to a supplier's address.

individuals.description: How many people, as best known.

notifiable.description: Whether it was decided notifiable; absent before the decision.

pdpc_due_on.description: Once decided notifiable: the last day to notify the PDPC, 3 calendar days after the decision.

pdpc_overdue.description: true when the PDPC is not notified and that day has passed.

prescribed.description: true when the data is prescribed: a name or identification number with pay, card or bank account numbers, or an account's identifier with its password. Such a breach is deemed to cause significant harm, so it is notifiable.

title.description: What happened, in a few words.
examples: A payroll file emailed to the wrong person
